basic_info.description: Great bay, city and park view. Hardwood floor in living and dining area. Unit has stainless steel appliances; dishwasher, stove/oven. Other appliances includes refrigerator, microwave, washer/dryer, garbage disposal and trash compactor. Kitchen is equipted with granite countertop. Unit includes a private balcony, double pane windows, sprinkler system, ceiling fans, central heat & A/C, cable-ready, high-speed internet ready, intercom system with wired controlled access, and storage outside the unit. The Arden is a full service building with 5 star amenities; secured gated property with security system, covered gated parking space ($300/mo), wheelchair access, barbecue with garden area, fenced yard, business center, clubhouse, on-site laundry, fitness center, and swimming pool. UCSF campus is across the street, few minutes walk to the AT&T park and Muni. agentId=5295398&credit&app for rental application.
